verdict.rationale: Tilled's merchant pricing templates (tilled-docs-9, tilled-docs-21) let ISVs set per-merchant pricing, which is the core mechanism for building in a markup/take-rate per seller, and onboarding docs (tilled-docs-8, tilled-docs-20) support managing many merchants under one platform. However, there is no evidence of an explicit 'application fee' object/API or a dashboard view that separates platform revenue from underlying processing costs — missing for 10: explicit application-fee/revenue-share API, and reporting that isolates ISV markup revenue from interchange/processing cost.
